verdict.rationale: Google's docs describe a documented recovery path — signing into your Google Account syncs codes across devices, explicitly to prevent lockout when changing devices — plus a manual QR-transfer option. However, multiple independent hands-on reports directly contradict this: users report codes not restoring after phone replacement, app updates/OS upgrades wiping all tokens, app data being excluded from device backups, and losing all 2FA if the linked Google account itself is banned/deleted — the exact failure the story asks to be prevented. missing for 10: consistent hands-on confirmation that sync survives updates/OS migrations without loss, and no dependency on the same Google account remaining accessible.
